paragraphs: Friend, that was a LOT of kings. Kings of the North, kings of the South, armies, alliances, daughters sent off to seal deals, and not one of those plans worked out the way its king wanted. Kings rise up, they do as they please, and then their kingdoms get broken up and handed to others (Daniel 11:3-4). Nobody in this vision gets to hold the oven forever, and I know that one personally.

Here's what I want you to hold onto. Even when the two kings sit at one table and speak lies, the end will still come "at the appointed time" (Daniel 11:27). Every plot, every siege and every big army is real, but none of them is in charge of the calendar. The One who sent the vision is, and that means you don't have to read the headlines like the kings wrote the ending.

Then comes the part for the people who love God. Hard days will come, and it says, "the people who know their God will firmly resist him" (Daniel 11:32). Those with insight will instruct many, and some of the wise will fall "so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless" (Daniel 11:33, 35). So keep knowing your God, baker, because that's what holds you steady when everything around you is loud. And this vision isn't finished yet, so keep that apron ON.
